diagnosis.root_cause: R84 R30BuildStageExtensionXyzrhwEyePlane reads original game screen_resolution only when CurrentRenderProducerToken equals StageExtensionTime. GOAL progress, time, original OutRunStagePrintf and B9200 result display travel the same finite-2D plane but otherwise decode native game pixels against physical XR RT viewport, causing a source/target extent mismatch when dimensions differ.
diagnosis.original_evidence: R30BuildStageExtensionXyzrhwEyePlane source branch explicitly says +TIME only and excludes GOAL; the shared per-eye renderer calls ProjectPixelPair for GOAL using state.viewport even though original 0x97xxx/0xBExxx producers originate in game presentation coordinates. This is a static source-math mismatch, not yet an HMD-observed confirmed root cause.
